bugs.what: A d20 check roll came up as exactly 4 three times in a row (steward's shade will checks, strongbox might check) and later 5 twice in a row (Hundred Gallery will checks) in quick succession, before finally varying — felt suspiciously non-random for a short streak, though not provably broken.
bugs.where: Barrow — King's Strongroom / Iron Downs — Hundred Gallery Fall

bugs.what: Companion mediation prompts ('call it a draw', 'not yours to grade') that are explicitly framed as the safe/neutral choice actually carry real fail chance and, on failure, cost regard with BOTH companions at once — worse than just picking a side. The framing undersells the risk.
bugs.where: various companion dispute dialogues (Lys/Tamsin, Osk/Tamsin, Osk/Vell)

bugs.what: A single hold (Iron Downs/Cinderhall) with all its side content consumed ~85 turns; three holds plus companion recruitment plus Act I consumed the full 480-turn allowance before Act III's Hollow Throne could be resolved, despite pursuing the game's own recommended 'three hollows' minimum path efficiently and skipping most of the 15 available holds entirely.

confusions: Early on, the reeve/priest barrow-door quest and the 'first Reeve's confession' requirement for the best ending were mentioned but never clearly pointed to a specific place to find that confession — I never located it and ran out of turns before Act III made it explicit.

Directional travel within a hold (e.g. 'three north, three east' from an NPC) required manually counting hops through many unnamed transit rooms; easy to lose count and no in-room confirmation of progress toward the stated target.
suggestions: Either raise the default turn budget for a full playthrough or telegraph earlier that '480 turns' really only supports Act I + ~3 holds + reaching Marrowgate, not resolving Act III — a mid-game status hint like 'at this pace you can rest N more holds before Coldpass closes' would help pacing decisions.
Make companion-mediation dialogue explicitly show the odds/stakes (like combat and skill checks already do) instead of implying 'draw' options are the safe/neutral pick when they can double-fail.
Add a lightweight on-screen breadcrumb (e.g. 'you are now 2 of 3 north') when following multi-hop NPC directions through a wilderness area.

Surface where to find 'the first Reeve's confession' proactively once the three-hollow/king-rested prerequisites are met, since it's the last missing piece for the best-flagged ending and easy to miss in a large hub city like Marrowgate.
